title: EUDI Relying Party Registration Checker
description: Check EUDI Wallet relying-party registration obligations and intended-use declaration under eIDAS 2.0 (Reg (EU) 2024/1183). Computes acceptance-deadline runway. EUDI Wallet by 31 Dec 2026; FI SCA ~Dec 2027.
